verdict.rationale: Zulip ships an official Python SDK/CLI installable via PyPI (pip install zulip) with hands-on verified functionality (zulip-send), a full machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.1 spec covering the REST API, and a live documented REST API confirmed working on a public server. This directly satisfies building against official SDKs for an AI-native/agentic workflow. Missing for 10: no evidence of SDKs in other languages (JS/Node, Go, etc.), no llms.txt or dedicated agent-facing docs, and no independent third-party corroboration of SDK quality beyond the hands-on probe.
